title: OJ's Optimizations
description: A set of mods that I personally use to get the best performance out of my Minecraft. It also has a couple handy mods.
body:
# **What is OJ's Optimizations?**
OJ's Optimizations is a modpack that has a lot of helpful mods to keep your Minecraft Fast and Smooth. It also has some helpful features, like ViaFabric Plus.
# **How do I Install it?**
- Install the Modrinth App
- When Downloading, click the "Install on Modrinth App" Button
- Click Install
- Click Play OR click the 3 dots at the top > Open Folder > mods, and copy all the mods to put into your minecraft.
# **Thanks for using OJ's Optimizations!**
